risk_note: RV2 (agent stream / orchestrator / store, db migration 0153). 规划 11-12 A2 (原 B3-08t; BR-AI-19 细则「运行级字段」, BR-AI-05 细则「上下文块」⑤): the terminal transaction (stream/pg/finalize.ts F5, same UPDATE as final_event, final_event IS NULL) now writes intent and the new column agent_runs.input_passed, and clears model / model_snapshot when the run's result used no model output; the other run fields (used model / snapshot, input / output tokens, ttft / latency from the injected Clock, output_filtered, filter_hits, output_truncated, page_guide_reject_reason) go through the existing RunTraceSink to createPgAgentTraceWriter.recordRunFields, value-overwrite so the B3-08y retry queue is idempotent. Principle (orchestrator D10-2368): run fields store only what was checked, otherwise empty — intent only from the intent port's recorded verdict, deterministic rules (scenario entry, link, no-model routing) or the first executed tool, never the model's own label; result_model only when that model's output was actually used; 判定顺序② own-order phrasing is a hard-coded positive list (orchestrator/intents/classify.ts OWN_ORDER_REQUESTS), nothing outside it is guessed. Migration 0153 adds input_passed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false (catalog-only, lock_timeout 5s) with column grants; schema.sql / db.gen.ts from the LAN test machine snapshot, main copy matched. Deferred by orchestrator scope rulings, both 「启用模型前必须」 and only reachable once the model path is on: D10-2362 FU-GATEWAY-FAILED-ATTEMPT-USAGE (model-gateway does not hand over usage of a failed but metered attempt; core already counts per attempt) into B4; D10-2377 FU-B3-08T-MODEL-ATTRIBUTION (model attribution of held text written late). Not in this task: cost_mfen (B4), the context block reading input_passed (B1).
